pages.title: Planetarium
pages.text: After you explore the dungeons on different planets, you will receive a decorative block-a planet as a souvenir. Right-click on them and give them a try. Feeding a redstone signal to a planetarium will cause it to spin.

pages.title: space painting
pages.text: In the treasure chests in the dungeon, you can also find some paintings from space. There are 14 space art paintings in total. If you paste it on the wall, one will be randomly selected and displayed, just like an ordinary painting.
